This website gathers my research interests, publications, and CV in one place, with an occasional short piece of writing.

This post exists to show what a post looks like. To add one, create a folder inside `posts/` with an `index.qmd` file in it. Footnotes[^1], quotations, mathematics, figures, and tables all work, and if you attach a bibliography file (`.bib`) the citations and reference list are generated automatically.
